title: rhine water level falls new lows halting sailings chokepoint 2026 08 12
text:
HAMBURG, Aug 12 (Reuters) - The river Rhine in Germany has fallen to new lows, stranding cargo vessels, the country’s ​inland navigation agency said on Wednesday, as Europe has entered another ‌heatwave.
